summary.text: Joshua J. Stonko, a Republican, represents District 42C (Carroll County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Stonko attended Carroll County public schools and earned a B.A. in economics from the University of Maryland in 2014.

The legislature's biography lists a career in banking in Baltimore and Washington, D.C., including positions at PNC from 2016 to 2022, J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. from 2022 to 2024 and Truist Bank from 2024 to 2026.
It lists Stonko's most recent position as ESOP and M&A Investment Banker and Market Leader at Lazear Capital beginning in 2026.
